question: Should OpenClaw intentionally hard-remove the already published `sessions.observer.ask` RPC in the current 2026.7 train, or preserve a documented compatibility window while supported clients migrate to `sessions.companion.*`?
rationale: The repository policy treats incompatible Gateway protocol changes as requiring explicit versioning and client follow-through; source evidence establishes the replacement path but cannot establish the state of independently deployed clients.

options.title: Retain a compatibility window
options.body: Keep the observer RPC as a documented deprecated adapter or preserve it until a versioned removal can ship with supported-client migration proof.

options.title: Approve hard removal
options.body: Accept that stale external clients will receive the standard unknown-method error and record the supported-client cutoff and release communication.

recommendation.title: Retain a compatibility window
recommendation.body: Keep the observer RPC as a documented deprecated adapter or preserve it until a versioned removal can ship with supported-client migration proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged companion work and this cleanup establish the clearest available ownership trail for the replacement contract.
